description: Create Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Cookies static pages as Angular standalone components, register routes, and update footer links
steps: Create src/app/features/public/privacy-policy/ directory with privacy-policy.component.ts, .html, .scss. Component class: PrivacyPolicyComponent, selector: app-privacy-policy. Import PageHeaderComponent from shared. Template contains professional privacy policy content with sections: Information we collect, How we use collected information, Data protection and security, Third-party services, User rights, Contact information. Include 'Last updated' date.

Create src/app/features/public/terms-of-service/ directory with terms-of-service.component.ts, .html, .scss. Component class: TermsOfServiceComponent, selector: app-terms-of-service. Import PageHeaderComponent. Template contains: Website usage rules, Orders and payments, Custom product/design upload responsibility, Intellectual property responsibility, Refund and cancellation policy, Account responsibility. Include 'Last updated' date.

Create src/app/features/public/cookies/ directory with cookies.component.ts, .html, .scss. Component class: CookiesComponent, selector: app-cookies. Import PageHeaderComponent. Template contains: What cookies are, Why we use cookies, Types of cookies (Essential, Analytics, Preference), How users can manage cookies. Include 'Last updated' date.

All three components should share a consistent SCSS styling approach using BEM naming (.legal-page, .legal-page__section, .legal-page__heading, etc.) and design tokens (--color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-surface, --space-*, --font-size-*, --radius-*, --font-weight-*). Make pages responsive with max-width container.

Register three new routes in src/app/app.routes.ts inside the public children array (BEFORE the wildcard '**' route): 'privacy-policy' -> PrivacyPolicyComponent, 'terms-of-service' -> TermsOfServiceComponent, 'cookies' -> CookiesComponent. Use lazy-loading pattern: loadComponent: () => import(...).then(m => m.ComponentName).

Update src/app/layout/footer/footer.component.html: Replace the three <a href='#'> links in the footer__legal-links section with routerLink directives: routerLink='/privacy-policy', routerLink='/terms-of-service', routerLink='/cookies'.
Verify TypeScript compilation passes with: NODE_OPTIONS="" tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json (run from project root).
acceptance_criteria: Three new component directories exist under src/app/features/public/ with correct file structure
All components are standalone (no NgModule) and use styleUrl (singular)
Each component uses PageHeaderComponent with appropriate title, subtitle, and breadcrumbs
SCSS uses BEM naming and design tokens from _design-tokens.scss
Pages are responsive (work on mobile and desktop)
Routes are registered in app.routes.ts before the '**' wildcard
Footer href='#' links are replaced with routerLink directives
verification: Run: NODE_OPTIONS="" tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json from the project root and confirm zero errors
Confirm footer.component.html contains routerLink='/privacy-policy', routerLink='/terms-of-service', routerLink='/cookies' and no href='#' in legal-links
Confirm the '**' wildcard route is still the last child route in public routes
findings: TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) fails for the entire project due to empty node_modules directories (@angular/core, tslib, etc. are empty). This is a pre-existing environment issue confirmed by running tsc on the base state before changes. The new component files have zero syntax or structural errors beyond the module resolution failures that affect all project files. All components follow existing patterns exactly.
